This page contains links to advice, how-tos, and plans for developing branding strategies and establishing best practices.
If you need something else, don't hesitate to ask [https://matrix.to/#/#kde-promo:kde.org Promo]. 
Some of the pages contain outdated content, so if you can update them, feel free to do so!

== KDE's brand resources ==
* [https://kde.org/stuff/clipart/ Download KDE's logo]
* [[Promo/Material/Mascots|Download KDE's mascots: Konqi and Katie]]
* [https://kde.org/contact/ KDE Press Kit (from 2019)]
* 
* [https://develop.kde.org/hig/style/color/default/ Breeze color palette - used for interfaces but can be applicable to promo material too].
* Breeze icons might be used in material by or about KDE as well. Get them from Cuttlefish, or [https://develop.kde.org/frameworks/breeze-icons/ learn more about Breeze Icons].
